name: Water
summary: Polar covalent molecule; universal solvent; hydrogen bonding; max density at 4C; essential for all life.

name: Hydrogen peroxide
summary: Strong oxidizer; antiseptic (3% solution); bleaches hair and paper; decomposes to H2O + O2.

name: Sodium chloride
summary: Table salt; ionic crystal; electrolyte in blood; preserves food; de-ices roads.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
summary: Baking soda; weak base; antacid; decomposes releasing CO2.

name: Sodium carbonate
summary: Washing soda; alkaline; used in glass, paper, soap.

name: Sodium hydroxide
summary: Lye/caustic soda; strong base; soap, paper, drain cleaner.

name: Potassium hydroxide
summary: Caustic potash; strong base; alkaline batteries; soft soap.

name: Calcium oxide (quicklime)
summary: Quicklime; reacts with water releasing heat; cement, steel, water treatment.

name: Calcium hydroxide (slaked lime)
summary: Slaked lime; weak base; mortar, plaster, water treatment.

name: Calcium carbonate
summary: Limestone, chalk, marble, shells; antacid; fizzes with acid releasing CO2.

name: Calcium sulfate
summary: Gypsum (dihydrate); plaster of Paris; drywall; sets when hydrated.

name: Potassium chloride
summary: Salt substitute for low-sodium diets; fertilizer (potash); lethal injection.

name: Potassium nitrate
summary: Saltpeter; strong oxidizer; gunpowder; fertilizer; food preservative.

name: Ammonium nitrate
summary: Fertilizer; explosive when mixed with fuel (ANFO); cold packs (endothermic dissolution).

name: Ammonia
summary: Pungent gas; weak base; fertilizer (Haber-Bosch); refrigerant; cleaning.

name: Hydrochloric acid
summary: Strong acid; stomach acid; steel pickling; PVC production.

name: Nitric acid
summary: Strong acid + oxidizer; nitrates; fertilizers (NH4NO3); explosives (TNT).

name: Sulfuric acid
summary: Strongest heavy acid; battery electrolyte; fertilizer (superphosphate); dehydrating agent.

name: Phosphoric acid
summary: Weak acid; cola flavoring; rust remover; fertilizer (TSP).

name: Acetic acid
summary: Weak acid; vinegar (4-7%); glacial freezes at 16.6C; ester feedstock.

name: Ethanol
summary: Polar protic solvent; psychoactive drug; fermentation product; sterilizes by denaturing proteins.

name: Methanol
summary: Wood alcohol; solvent; antifreeze; fuel; TOXIC (causes blindness).

name: Glycerol
summary: Glycerin; sweet, viscous; soap byproduct; moisturizer; e-cigarette base; nitroglycerin feedstock.

name: Glucose
summary: Monosaccharide; blood sugar; cellular fuel; photosynthesis product; reducing sugar (Fehling's).

name: Sucrose
summary: Disaccharide of glucose+fructose; table sugar; hydrolyzes to invert sugar; ferments to ethanol.

name: Caffeine
summary: Methylxanthine alkaloid; adenosine antagonist; stimulant; coffee/tea/cacao.

name: Methane
summary: Simplest hydrocarbon; natural gas; GHG 80x CO2; produced anaerobically; flammable.

name: Ethane
summary: Natural gas component; cracking to ethylene (polyethylene); refrigerant.

name: Ethylene
summary: Plant hormone; polyethylene feedstock; most-produced organic compound globally.

name: Acetylene
summary: Triple-bond HC; hot flame (3000C with O2); welding; very unstable under pressure.

name: Propane
summary: LPG component; BBQ fuel; heating; refrigerant; petrochemical feedstock.

name: Butane
summary: LPG; lighter fuel; aerosol propellant; refrigerant.

name: Octane
summary: Alkane; gasoline reference (100 octane rating); flammable.

name: Benzene
summary: Aromatic ring; solvent; petrochemical feedstock; CARCINOGEN (leukemia).

name: Phenol
summary: Aromatic alcohol; disinfectant (Lister); Bakelite feedstock; burns skin easily.

name: Aniline
summary: Aromatic amine; dye precursor (mauve); polyurethane feedstock; toxic.

name: Formaldehyde
summary: Simplest aldehyde; tissue fixative; resins (urea-formaldehyde, Bakelite); CARCINOGEN.

name: Dichloromethane
summary: Methylene chloride; solvent (paint stripper, decaffeination); suspected carcinogen.

name: Acetonitrile
summary: Nitrile solvent; HPLC mobile phase; lithium-ion battery electrolyte; toxic to cyanide.

name: Acetone
summary: Ketone solvent; nail polish remover; volatile; ketone body in diabetes.

name: Ethyl acetate
summary: Ester solvent; fruity odor; nail polish; chromatography; decaffeination.

name: Methyl formate
summary: Ester; fumigant; refrigerant; precursor to formic acid.

name: Copper(II) sulfate
summary: Blue hydrated salt; electroplating; fungicide (Bordeaux); algicide; biuret reagent.

name: Copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate
summary: Blue vitriol; loses water on heating → white anhydrous; electroplating; fungicide.

name: Iron(III) oxide
summary: Hematite; rust (with water); red pigment; iron ore; polishing compound (jeweler's rouge).

name: Iron(III) chloride
summary: Lewis acid catalyst; etching PCB; water treatment flocculant.

name: Iron(II) sulfate
summary: Copperas; iron supplement; ink (gallotannate); Mohr's salt; reducing agent.

name: Potassium permanganate
summary: Strong oxidizer; disinfectant; titration (redox); water treatment; stains skin brown.

name: Potassium dichromate
summary: Strong oxidizer; cleaning solution; CARCINOGEN (Cr(VI)); titration.

name: Silver nitrate
summary: Soluble silver salt; photography; cautery (lunar caustic); staining; chlorine test.

name: Barium chloride
summary: Soluble barium salt; sulfate test (white BaSO4 precipitate); TOXIC (Ba2+).

name: Barium sulfate
summary: Insoluble (barium meal for X-ray); paint pigment (blanc fixe); drilling mud.

name: Lead(II) nitrate
summary: Soluble lead salt; pigment (chrome yellow); gold cyanidation; TOXIC (cumulative).

name: Lead(II) sulfide
summary: Galena (main lead ore); infrared detector; very insoluble.

name: Mercury(II) sulfide
summary: Cinnabar (ore of mercury); red pigment (vermilion); Chinese red ink.

name: Iodine
summary: Halogen; sublimes to violet vapor; antiseptic; KI added to table salt; starch indicator.

name: Bromine
summary: Only liquid nonmetal at room temp; strong oxidizer; flame retardants; water disinfectant.

name: Chlorine
summary: Toxic gas; water disinfection; PVC plastic; bleaches; chlor-alkali process.

name: Ozone
summary: Triatomic oxygen; stratospheric UV shield; ground-level pollutant; strong oxidizer; sharp smell.

name: Sulfur dioxide
summary: Pungent; volcanic; acid rain (→ H2SO3); wine preservative; bleaching.

name: Carbon dioxide
summary: Colorless; respiration byproduct; GHG; dry ice solid; soda carbonation; fire extinguisher.

name: Carbon monoxide
summary: Colorless, odorless, tasteless; binds hemoglobin 200x O2; deadly; car exhaust; partial combustion.

name: Nitrogen dioxide
summary: Brown; toxic; smog component; nitric acid precursor; equilibrium N2O4 ↔ 2NO2.

name: Nitric oxide
summary: Colorless; vasodilator (signaling molecule in body); combustion byproduct; oxidizes to NO2.

name: Nitrous oxide
summary: Laughing gas; anesthetic; whipped cream propellant; GHG; rocketry oxidizer.

name: Silicon dioxide
summary: Silica; quartz, sand, glass; earth's crust #2; covalent network; chromatography column.

name: Aluminum oxide
summary: Alumina; corundum (ruby/sapphire); abrasives; ceramic; chromatography (basic alumina).

name: Titanium dioxide
summary: Titania; white pigment (paint, sunscreen); photocatalyst; food coloring (E171).

name: Zinc oxide
summary: Sunscreen (UV blocker); calamine lotion; white pigment; semiconductor (LED).

name: Manganese dioxide
summary: Pyrolusite; alkaline battery depolarizer; glass decolorizer; oxidizer.

name: Potassium chlorate
summary: Strong oxidizer; matches; fireworks; oxygen generation in labs (heating); safety match heads.

name: Potassium carbonate
summary: Potash; pearl ash; mild base; soap, glass, Dutch-processed cocoa.

name: Lithium carbonate
summary: Mood stabilizer (bipolar); lithium battery precursor; low solubility (lithium ore purification).

name: Lithium iron phosphate
summary: Olivine structure; LFP battery cathode (safe, long cycle life, lower energy density than NMC).

name: Citric acid
summary: Weak triprotic acid; citrus fruits; food acidulant; pH buffer; descaler; Krebs cycle intermediate.

name: Malic acid
summary: Dicarboxylic acid; apple flavor; food additive; sour candy; Krebs cycle intermediate.

name: Tartaric acid
summary: Dicarboxylic acid; grapes; baking powder (cream of tartar); wine; chiral; Fehling's reagent.

name: Sodium benzoate
summary: Food preservative (E211); soft drinks, jams; effective in acidic pH; potential benzene in vitamin C.

name: Testosterone
summary: Androgen steroid hormone; male development; muscle mass; sperm production; doping agent.

name: Cannabidiol (CBD)
summary: Non-psychoactive cannabis compound; epilepsy (Epidiolex); anxiety; sleep aid; anti-inflammatory.

name: Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC)
summary: Psychoactive cannabis compound; CB1 agonist; appetite stimulant; antiemetic; recreational use.

name: Amphetamine
summary: CNS stimulant; ADHD (Adderall); narcolepsy; banned doping agent; highly addictive (methamphetamine).

name: Cocaine
summary: Tropane alkaloid (coca plant); local anesthetic; Schedule II; dopamine reuptake inhibitor; recreational.

name: Methamphetamine
summary: CNS stimulant; powerful dopamine release; Schedule II (ADHD rare); illicit recreational (crystal meth).

name: Lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD)
summary: Ergot alkaloid; 5-HT2A agonist; potent psychedelic (~25 µg active); hallucinations; banned globally.

name: Caffeine
summary: Methylxanthine alkaloid; adenosine antagonist; stimulant; coffee/tea/cacao; world's most-consumed psychoactive.

name: Saccharin
summary: Oldest artificial sweetener (300-400x sucrose); suspected carcinogen (now cleared); found in coal tar research.

name: Aspartame
summary: Dipeptide methyl ester (aspartame + phenylalanine); 200x sucrose; breaks down at high heat; banned in phenylketonuria.

name: Vanillin
summary: Vanilla flavor compound; main vanilla extract component; synthetic from guaiacol (lignin) or petrochemical.
